speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. Given your diabetes and the progressive nature of the symptoms, could you describe the specific pattern of numbness and exactly where you feel the weakness in your hands? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your bladder or bowel control?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Burning pain in neck and arms, and weakness in both hands. I also have Paresthesias in hands, Absent reflexes, Decreased hand grip with fasciculations. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) with concurrent diabetic neuropathy.
